title: Pet of the Week: Ozzy - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Bonham ,
1 days ago EUGENE, Ore. – Meet Ozzy, a soft, calm, and gentle senior gentleman of a lionhead rabbit who’s looking for his forever home, hopefully with other bunny companions!. According to the Greenhill Humane Society, seven-year-old Ozzy has a very calm demeanor, loves being loved on, and getting cheek scritches. Lap time is a favorite part of his day and Ozzy is quite active for his age with a tremendous sense of curiosity about the world around him. Ozzy has lived with many bunny companions in the past and would love to live in a household with another friend. Staffers say that, ideally, Ozzy would like to find a calm home that can give him the quality golden years he deserves and that Greenhill has plenty of resources available related to rabbit care.
